gaps.sentence: I can't imagine ___ in a tiny village again.
He's considering ___ his job and travelling for a year.
We mustn't miss ___ this exhibition — it ends on Sunday.
I look forward to ___ your suggestions at the meeting.
Do you know how ___ this machine?
gaps.explanation: know how/what/where + to-infinitive: know how to operate.

gaps.sentence: I really can't afford ___ on holiday this year.
gaps.explanation: afford takes the to-infinitive: can't afford to go.

gaps.sentence: You should stop ___ so much coffee late at night.
gaps.explanation: stop + -ing = end the activity: stop drinking coffee.

gaps.sentence: They agreed ___ the deadline by a week.
gaps.explanation: 'Agree to do something' takes the to-infinitive.
